usage: capture_reference.py [-h] [--backend {python,native}]
                            [--physics-config PHYSICS_CONFIG]
                            [--road-resolution ROAD_RESOLUTION]
                            [--sensor-period SENSOR_PERIOD]
                            [--rider-program RIDER_PROGRAM] [--policy POLICY]
                            [--record] [--check-policy {strict,diagnostic}]
                            [--diagnostic-model-limits]
                            [--scenario {flat,uphill,rough_uphill,crest,low_grip,step_up,generated,alpine}]
                            [--gen-spec GEN_SPEC] [--track-file TRACK_FILE]
                            [--seed SEED]
                            [--rider {lumped,articulated_planar}]
                            [--rider-mass RIDER_MASS]
                            [--rider-height RIDER_HEIGHT] [--rider-random]
                            [--rider-seed RIDER_SEED]
                            [--posture {neutral,forward,crouched,standing}]
                            [--duration DURATION] [--dt DT]
                            [--control-period CONTROL_PERIOD]
                            [--actuator-delay ACTUATOR_DELAY]
                            [--sensor-delay SENSOR_DELAY] [--ideal-sensors]
                            [--initial-brake-demand INITIAL_BRAKE_DEMAND]
                            [--initial-speed INITIAL_SPEED]
                            [--human-torque HUMAN_TORQUE]
                            [--motor-torque MOTOR_TORQUE] [--demand DEMAND]
                            [--demand-file DEMAND_FILE] [--assist]
                            [--motor-limit MOTOR_LIMIT]
                            [--motor-max-torque MOTOR_MAX_TORQUE]
                            [--motor-max-power MOTOR_MAX_POWER]
                            [--transmission {elastic_chain,ideal_mid_drive,geometric_ideal_mid_drive}]
                            [--chain-stiffness CHAIN_STIFFNESS]
                            [--freehub-stiffness FREEHUB_STIFFNESS]
                            [--front-teeth FRONT_TEETH]
                            [--rear-teeth REAR_TEETH] [--fast-telemetry]
                            [--record-decimation RECORD_DECIMATION]
                            [--energy-tolerance ENERGY_TOLERANCE] [--out OUT]
                            [--overwrite]

Headless torque-control experiments; all dependencies are in the offline
bundle.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --backend {python,native}
                        headless research backend; no automatic fallback
  --physics-config PHYSICS_CONFIG
  --road-resolution ROAD_RESOLUTION
                        compiled road spacing, m
  --sensor-period SENSOR_PERIOD
                        acquisition period, s
  --rider-program RIDER_PROGRAM
  --policy POLICY       motor policy factory, module:factory
  --record              retain every accounted interval in RAM and publish one
                        run at launch end
  --check-policy {strict,diagnostic}
                        model-check policy, independent of recording (default:
                        strict)
  --diagnostic-model-limits
                        continue out-of-scope diagnostic runs; validity
                        remains false
  --scenario {flat,uphill,rough_uphill,crest,low_grip,step_up,generated,alpine}
                        'generated' draws a seeded procedural rough climb,
                        'alpine' a seeded alpine scree climb (see --gen-spec);
                        the seed is --seed
  --gen-spec GEN_SPEC   TOML of generator ranges: TerrainGenSpec for
                        --scenario generated, AlpineGenSpec for --scenario
                        alpine
  --track-file TRACK_FILE
                        TOML overrides --scenario; preserves its authored
                        seed/geometry
  --seed SEED
  --rider {lumped,articulated_planar}
  --rider-mass RIDER_MASS
                        kg
  --rider-height RIDER_HEIGHT
                        m
  --rider-random        sample rider mass/height/posture/effort from --rider-
                        seed (articulated rider; replaces --rider-
                        mass/-height)
  --rider-seed RIDER_SEED
                        default: --seed
  --posture {neutral,forward,crouched,standing}
  --duration DURATION   simulation seconds (10-30 s episodes are supported;
                        see --record-decimation)
  --dt DT               physics timestep, seconds (default: 0.0005 for the
                        ideal transmissions, validated by
                        tools/validate_antiwheelie.py; 0.000125 for
                        elastic_chain, whose low gears oscillate at 0.5 ms)
  --control-period CONTROL_PERIOD
                        seconds, integer multiple of --dt
  --actuator-delay ACTUATOR_DELAY
                        seconds, integer multiple of --dt
  --sensor-delay SENSOR_DELAY
                        seconds
  --ideal-sensors       zero noise and zero sensor latency
  --initial-brake-demand INITIAL_BRAKE_DEMAND
                        both brakes during static initialization only;
                        released at t=0
  --initial-speed INITIAL_SPEED
                        m/s (unlike legacy bike-ride km/h)
  --human-torque HUMAN_TORQUE
                        mean crank torque, N*m
  --motor-torque MOTOR_TORQUE
                        external crank-side assist ceiling, N*m; forward
                        cranks and rider torque are required
  --demand DEMAND       constant assist ceiling, N*m: advisory echo as
                        env.demand_nm; the CLI loop passes it to the motor
                        controller
  --demand-file DEMAND_FILE
                        DemandProgram TOML ([[keyframes]] time_s/torque_nm)
  --assist              use configured pedelec support without an external
                        motor ceiling
  --motor-limit MOTOR_LIMIT
                        immediate crank-side safety ceiling, N*m
  --motor-max-torque MOTOR_MAX_TORQUE
                        synthetic motor envelope, N*m
  --motor-max-power MOTOR_MAX_POWER
                        synthetic shaft power envelope, W
  --transmission {elastic_chain,ideal_mid_drive,geometric_ideal_mid_drive}
                        ideal_mid_drive: one-way tendon, cheap, omits chain-
                        growth/suspension coupling; geometric_ideal_mid_drive:
                        experimental, tendon linearized from the chain
                        geometry; elastic_chain: frozen reference for A/B
                        comparison
  --chain-stiffness CHAIN_STIFFNESS
                        override chain spring rate, N/m
  --freehub-stiffness FREEHUB_STIFFNESS
                        override freehub spring rate, N*m/rad
  --front-teeth FRONT_TEETH
  --rear-teeth REAR_TEETH
  --fast-telemetry      evaluate period telemetry in a spawned worker process;
                        samples and model_status surface one step later, and
                        channels snapshotted from rider effort diagnostics in
                        that window can differ from a synchronous run --
                        episodes are not guaranteed bitwise-identical to
                        --serial runs
  --record-decimation RECORD_DECIMATION
                        expensive-measurement cadence; --record still retains
                        every accounted physics interval
  --energy-tolerance ENERGY_TOLERANCE
                        maximum normalized numerical energy residual
  --out OUT
  --overwrite           legacy compatibility flag; new recordings always use
                        exclusive unique directories
